title: TERRIBLE PACKAGING CAUSES DENTS AND PARTICLE BOARD CHIPS
text: TERRIBLE PACKAGING CAUSES DENTS AND PARTICLE BOARD CHIPS. The packaging was terrible on this product. No corner pieces to prevent chips so the top table has a chip and almost ever piece of this PARTICLE BOARD product is chipped or scratched or cracked. The assembly was also poorly done as you'll see in a pic of how the screw was put into the board too close to the edge causing it to split. I have not yet assembled it, as I got it last night and today spent my morning cleaning up the blown in tiny Styrofoam pellets, which SHOULD HAVE BEEN corrugated paper and thicker  sheets of Styrofoam (as this was super thin and cheap packaging materials).  NOT ALL WOOD, particle board is technically sawdust glued together, but the top seems to be wooden, with a corner chip in it upon arrival.
